definitions.full: H5653. Abda עַבְדָּא proper name, masculine ( servant of ׳י (= עֹבַדְיָה 1Chr 9:16 = Neh 11:17 ), but form dubious, see ᵐ5 ); — 1 father of adoniram 1Kin 4:6 ; ᵐ5 Εφρα , A Αβαω , ᵐ5 L Εδραμ . 2 a Levite Neh 11:17 ; ᵐ5 Ωβηβ , A Ιωβηβ , ᵐ5 L Αβδιας .
